chars.AZIZ: AZIZ: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hooded work sweatshirt, dark blue jeans and brown work boots.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young woman wearing a loose burgundy headscarf wrapped over her head and an emerald-green long house dress with gold trim, a fully covered modest outfit.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a simple rural Moroccan house room in a village (douar) in the Tadla plains: patterned red carpets, low cushions along the walls, a small window. SALMA sits on a cushion crying with her mitten hands over her eyes, tears on her face, while AZIZ sits on another cushion across from her, leaning forward, worried and uncomfortable. Tense, emotional.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same rural Moroccan room with red carpets and low cushions. AZIZ sits at a respectful distance and talks gently to SALMA with an open calming hand gesture, trying to comfort her; SALMA wipes her tears and looks at him. A glass of mint tea on a small round table between them.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same rural Moroccan room. SALMA has moved closer on the cushion and placed her mitten hand on AZIZ's knee; AZIZ freezes and stares down at the hand, shocked, eyes wide. Medium shot, both seated side by side.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same rural Moroccan room. SALMA leans toward AZIZ with a flirtatious look, tilting her head; AZIZ leans far back away from her, both hands raised in front of him in refusal, sweat drop on his head. Clear tension between them.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of AZIZ sitting stiffly on a cushion in the rural Moroccan room, completely shocked: wide dot eyes, open mouth, a sweat drop, frozen. Warm dim lamp light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same rural Moroccan room. AZIZ has jumped to his feet and steps back toward the wooden door, pointing at SALMA with an angry, horrified face; SALMA stays seated on the cushion looking up at him, unbothered and determined.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AZIZ stands alone in the doorway of the rural Moroccan house at dusk, holding his head with both mitten hands, dizzy and confused, swirl lines around his head, the dusty village path and olive trees behind him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the rural Moroccan room at night, lamp light. SALMA stands close in front of AZIZ, one mitten hand on her chest, looking at him intensely as if confessing a secret love; AZIZ stares back at her in total disbelief. Dramatic, tense.
